rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8972, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE SOLO PARENTSêžŒ WELFARE ACT OF 2000, PROVIDING FOR ADDITIONAL BENEFITS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Intends to lighten the burdens of solo parenting and sustain their child's basic needs by
expanding the coverage and benefits of R.A.No.8972.

Proposes to provide twenty percent (20%) discount on tuition and miscellaneous fees, per child,
from grade school to college on any educational institution and state colleges and universities;
provided that a single parent who is receiving support from the child's other parent shall not
be eligible to receive the benefit.

Provides that any person or establishment who violates the provisions of this Act by denying or 
hindering a solo parent from availing any of these benefits shall suffer penalties as provided
in this Act.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AND PROVIDING FOR THE RATIONALIZATION OF WAGE LEVELS ON A NATIONAL OR INDUSTRIAL BASIS
rows.abstract:
Aims to address the inadequate and inequitable regional wage levels to the evolving economic realities and intended decent living conditions of a minimum wage earner and his family.

Seeks to replace the Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Boards with the National Wages and Productivity Commission, to address regional wage distortions and harmonize regional wage levels and determine and fix that of the agricultural and non-agricultural Industries at least once every year.

Intends to ensure strict compliance on the payment of the mandated regional minimum wages by increasing the penalty for non-compliance with a fine in the amount double of the amount of wage denied to workers or P150,000.00 whichever is higher; and in cases where a fine is decreed by DOLE or the NLRC but cannot be satisfied because of the unavailability or inadequacy of funds, the assets of the owners, president, and/or officers of the corporation or any other entity, or fraction thereof, either movable or immovable property shall be the subject of a summary forfeiture and garnishment proceeding for litigation.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING AN URGENT, COMPREHENSIVE, AND INTEGRATED LAND-BASED TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT TO EFFECTIVELY ADDRESS THE TRAFFIC CONGESTION CRISIS IN MANILA, METROPOLITAN CEBU, AND METROPOLITAN DAVAO AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Declares and recognize that the traffic crisis is in the nature of a man-made calamity or catastrophe; that time is of the essence and immediate action is urgently necessary to prevent further damage to the national economy, public health, and social welfare or loss of life and property as a result of the traffic crisis; and that there is urgent necessity as well to restore, improve, and make accessible vital public transportation services, infrastructure, and facilities.

Seeks to reserve funds to facilitate the improvement and enhancement of PUVs in the metropolitan areas through conduct of roadworthiness testing.

States that the DBP shall extend financial assistance to existing public transportation operators with valid franchise to enable them to modernize their units and can only offer the loan facility for procurement of vehicles with engines that are Euro 4-compliant, hybrid, fully electric-powered or those which are more environment-friendly and are accessible to PWDs.

Proposes to create a Special Traffic Crisis Court in each of the metropolitan areas which shall have exclusive jurisdiction to hear and expeditiously resolve all actions that may emanate from the implementation herein.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2019-07-23

rows.title_full: AN ACT RIGHTSIZING THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT TO IMPROVE PUBLIC SERVICE DELIVERY
rows.abstract:
\"Rightsizing the National Government Act\"

Seeks to authorize the President to rightsized the executive branch of the government in order to promote a more streamlined and efficient system of operations; and also grants the heads of the Legislature, the Judiciary, Constitutional Offices, LGUS, and SUCs the same authority within their authorized appropriations.

Proposes the creation of the Committee on Rightsizing the National Government which shall oversee
the implementation of this rationalization program aimed at streamlining national government agency
operations thereby promoting a more efficient system of delivery of services.

Intends to ensure a more sustainable pattern of public expenditure through a leaner yet more responsive and effective bureaucracy.
